selection_basis: explicit comparison, not an aggregate score

9589.frame_one_hook: strong; the complete six-shell challenge and locked hook are immediately legible
9589.early_activity: collision at 0.209 s and first outward exit at 1.739 s; first near miss is later at 5.245 s
9589.near_miss_quality: best overall distribution: 1 opening, 10 middle, 4 late; flashes remain local and the ornament stays subordinate
9589.route_uncertainty: balanced 3-opening/3-break route with distinct route changes through the middle and late sections
9589.damage_progression: 17 breaks with strong persistent geometry change and no loss of ball clarity
9589.visual_clarity: strong; damage, missing passages, moving openings, and outward region remain readable
9589.musical_pleasantness: best balance of pace and space: 2.958 Hz collision density, 0.277 s median gap, 6.03 LU LRA, maximum identical-note run 2
9589.audiovisual_causality: pass; all cue classes share the playback digest and stay below one frame
9589.middle_section_evolution: strongest: 10 near misses, 10 breaks, and 6 shell exits in the middle segment
9589.outer_shell_tension: 6.233 s from first arrival in region 5 to final escape, supported by 23 late collisions and 5 late breaks
9589.final_escape: clean opening escape with immediate visual release, D-major resolution, and exact source silence
9589.replay_appeal: highest; prediction, damage, route changes, and musical register changes remain active without feeling over-dense

11929.early_activity: first collision and near miss coincide at 0.298 s; first exit at 1.653 s and first break at 2.140 s
11929.near_miss_quality: excellent opening signal: 5 opening, 3 middle, 4 late
11929.visual_clarity: strong, although the denser opening asks more attention than 9589
11929.musical_pleasantness: energetic but busier: 3.475 Hz collision density, 0.194 s median gap, and narrower 3.86 LU LRA
11929.audiovisual_causality: pass; all cue classes share the playback digest and stay below one frame
11929.middle_section_evolution: good; sustained break-led change, but frontier progress reaches region 5 by 12.775 s
11929.outer_shell_tension: 9.288 s from region 5 to the final break; exciting but less compact than 9589
11929.final_escape: the visible final panel break and chord bloom land as one decisive event before resolution
11929.replay_appeal: high; strongest alternative because the route and break ending contrast with 9589

3654.early_activity: fast collision at 0.199 s, exit at 1.511 s, and break at 2.041 s
3654.near_miss_quality: good but later first prediction at 3.571 s
3654.damage_progression: only 9 breaks; clean but visibly less consequential
3654.musical_pleasantness: cleanest and least overlapped, but also the least rich of the four
3654.middle_section_evolution: rejecting defect: approximately 12.04 s between first-time region 3 and region 4 progress
3654.replay_appeal: moderate; the clean control repeats Test #1's largely unchanged-middle weakness

7699.early_activity: fastest collision at 0.189 s and early near miss at 1.034 s, but first exit waits until 2.991 s
7699.route_uncertainty: strong locally, with a 4-opening/2-break route, but progress stalls twice
7699.damage_progression: strongest accumulated visual state with 18 breaks

7699.outer_shell_tension: 10.770 s from region 5 to escape, the longest of the cast
